title: Mode Connectivity Beyond Classifiers: Evidence from Generative and Contrastive Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.30366v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The loss landscape of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) exhibits highly complex and non-convex properties. Recent studies have revealed the phenomenon of mode connectivity, demonstrating that independently trained network modes can be connected via a continuous low-loss path. However, existing mode connectivity research is predominantly confined to classifier-based models, leaving it an open question whether similar geometric properties exist in modern complex models. In this paper, we extend the boundaries of mode connectivity to generative and contrastive domains (specifically DDPM and NanoCLIP). Addressing the unique architecture of DDPM and CLIP, we propose an architecture-aware connection building algorithm. Extensive empirical results demonstrate for the first time that we successfully discover mode connectivity between independently trained DDPM and NanoCLIP modes. translated_title: 超越分类器的模式连接：来自生成模型与对比学习模型的证据
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNN）的损失景观表现出高度复杂和非凸的特性。近期研究揭示了模式连接现象，证明独立训练的网络模式可以通过连续的低损失路径连接起来。然而，现有的模式连接研究主要局限于基于分类器的模型，类似的几何性质是否存在于现代复杂模型中仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们将模式连接的边界扩展到生成模型和对比学习领域（具体为DDPM和NanoCLIP）。针对DDPM和CLIP的独特架构，我们提出了一种架构感知的连接构建算法。大量实证结果首次证明，我们成功地发现了独立训练的DDPM和NanoCLIP模式之间的模式连接。我们的工作为理解损失景观的几何性质提供了全新的视角。
tldr: 本文首次将模式连接现象从分类器扩展到生成模型（DDPM）和对比学习模型（NanoCLIP），提出架构感知的连接构建算法，证明独立训练的生成与对比模型之间同样存在低损失路径连接。
en_tdlr: This paper extends mode connectivity beyond classifiers to generative and contrastive models (DDPM and NanoCLIP) for the first time, proposing an architecture-aware connection building algorithm that demonstrates independently trained DDPM and NanoCLIP modes can be connected via continuous low-loss paths.
